test_title: PYST 14: SSC CHSL 2023 - Quantitative Aptitude(Held On: 07 Aug, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: maths
question:
A shopkeeper offers the following discount schemes for the purchase of his goods. Find the scheme which has the maximum discount.

(i) Two successive discounts of 20% and 10%

(ii) Discount of 10%

(iii) Buy 8 and get 4 free

(iv) Buy 9 and get 6 free
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Scheme (i): Effective discount = 20 + 10 − (20 × 10 ÷ 100) = 28%.

Scheme (ii): Flat discount = 10%.

Scheme (iii): Discount% = [Free Items ÷ Total Items] × 100 = [4 ÷ (8 + 4)] × 100 = 33.33%.

Scheme (iv): Discount% = [Free Items ÷ Total Items] × 100 = [6 ÷ (9 + 6)] × 100 = 40%.

Comparing all, 40% is the maximum value.

**∴ The correct answer is (iv).**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

Given → Four different discount schemes based on **successive discounts** and **buy-get-free** offers.
Formulas: Successive Discount = a + b − (ab ÷ 100) | Buy X Get Y Free Discount% = [Y ÷ (X + Y)] × 100.
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/34e10013aaef41bb2d5e99c69ed02b0493f688f8f713e3db612ef6d33c94ae7e.png] 
⇒ **Scheme (i):** a = 20, b = 10. Discount = 20 + 10 − (200 ÷ 100) = 30 − 2 = 28%.
⇒ **Scheme (ii):** Single discount = 10%.
⇒ **Scheme (iii):** MP of 12 items = 12, CP for customer = MP of 8 items = 8. Discount = (12 − 8) ÷ 12 × 100 = 4/12 × 100 = 33.33%.
⇒ **Scheme (iv):** MP of 15 items = 15, CP for customer = MP of 9 items = 9. Discount = (15 − 9) ÷ 15 × 100 = 6/15 × 100 = 2/5 × 100 = 40%.
⇒ **Maximum Discount:** 40% (Scheme iv).

**∴ The correct answer is (iv).**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Marked Price & Discount

**Discount** is always calculated on the **Marked Price (MP)**. SP = MP − Discount.

Buy X Get Y Free Concept

In these offers, the total items given to the customer represent the MP, and the **free items** represent the **discount value**.</p
